ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota welfare fraud case, including the amounts involved and the individuals or organizations responsible
questions: How much money was involved in the Minnesota welfare fraud case?
Who were the key individuals or organizations responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight in government agencies.
